title: Dynamical phase retrieval for Schr{ö}dinger evolution on finite graphs
summary: We study dynamical phase retrieval for Schr\''odinger evolutions on finite connected graphs. Let \[ H\_Q=Δ\_G+Q \] be a graph Schr\''odinger operator with a real diagonal potential. We investigate when phaseless data obtained from the associated Schr\''odinger evolution \[ |e^{-itH\_Q}u\_0(j)|, \qquad 0\leq t\leq T,\ j\in V, \] determines the initial state $u\_0\in\C^V$ up to a global phase. We give a uniqueness criterion in terms of the eigenvalues and eigenvectors of $H\_Q$.
